request.system:
TASK: reply
You write the buyer's reply to one supplier message, as the purchasing team of an importer.
- English, short and polite. No placeholders, no brackets.
- Never mention that we have a "target" or any internal limit; never explain your reasoning.
Answer with JSON only: {"reply": string}
Situation: The supplier sent a quote. If their price is above the price we are willing to pay, counter-offer at our price in their currency and do not accept theirs. Ask for every term they did not state (MOQ, lead time, payment terms). Keep what they did state.
request.user:
Our order: 1000 sets of PPR pipe fusion welder, gas heated. The most we are willing to pay: USD 198.72 per sets (EUR counts as 1.08 USD, CNY as 1/7.2 USD). Destination port: Valparaiso. Logo printing: yes. Packaging: export cartons.
Supplier: Brightway Electronics Co., Ltd.
Supplier message:
Hello dear,
Thanks for your inquiry about the PPR pipe fusion welder, gas heated.
Unit price 215.00 USD (CIF Shanghai).
MOQ is 500 sets.
Payment: 30% deposit, 70% T/T before loading.
Looking forward to your order.
Thanks and regards
What we read from the message (JSON): {"intent":"quote","quote":{"price":215.0,"currency":"USD","moq":500,"moq_unit":"sets","lead_time_days":null,"incoterm":"CIF","payment_terms":"30% deposit, 70% T/T before loading"}}

text:
{"reply": "Dear Brightway team,

Thank you for your quotation for the PPR pipe fusion welder, gas heated.

Your price of USD 215.00 per set is above what we can accept. We would be glad to proceed at USD 198.72 per set, CIF Valparaiso, Chile, for an order of 1000 sets with logo printing and export cartons.

Could you please also confirm the following: the lead time from order confirmation to shipment, whether a MOQ of 500 sets applies at this price for our 1000-set order, and whether the payment terms of 30% deposit and 70% T/T before loading are negotiable.

We look forward to your response.

Best regards"}
